DRead the text and complete it with was, were, wasn’t or weren’t. Then answer the questions.

Our Trip to the Zoo

Last Saturday a great day for our class. We on a school trip to the zoo. The weather warm and sunny. Our teacher, Mrs Kaya, very excited. The lions asleep, but the monkeys . They very noisy! My best friend Deniz with us because he ill. In the evening, we tired but happy.

  1. 1

    Where were the students last Saturday?

  2. 2

    How was the weather?

  3. 3

    Were the lions awake?

  4. 4

    Why wasn’t Deniz on the trip?
